in_marathi.name: Ikshithansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's manifestation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ikshithansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ikshithansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ikshita' (wished for) and 'Ansh' (manifestation or form). This name is believed to represent Lord Shiva's manifestation in the form of a child, evoking feelings of divine protection and strength.
